offers.description: Ready to Get Shit Done?At bunq, we're reshaping how people experience banking globally. Our website is the digital front door, where millions of potential users first discover who we are, what we offer, and why they should trust us. As a Website Lead, your mission is to own the entire website experience from strategy through execution, making sure our digital presence converts visitors into loyal users and establishes bunq as the go-to fintech solution.Your role is to build, optimize, and scale bunq.com into a high-performing, conversion-focused asset that tells our story compellingly and gets users to sign up or download our app.Take OwnershipAs a Website Lead, you'll own:Develop and execute the website strategy, including technical SEO, conversion optimization, content roadmap, and mobile-first UX, driving measurable growth in sign-ups and app downloads.Lead website performance and optimization, implementing A/B tests, analyzing conversion funnels, identifying bottlenecks, and continuously improving KPIs (speed, engagement, conversion rate).Own the website tech stack and roadmap, ensuring the site scales, performs at speed, and is built with modern best practices (accessibility, mobile, core web vitals).What You'll Work on Right AwayConversion Funnel Audit: Conduct a deep-dive analysis of bunq.com's current user journey from landing to sign-up, identifying friction points and quick wins to improve conversion rate.Mobile-First Optimization: Overhaul mobile UX and performance

Our website is the digital front door, where millions of potential users first discover who we are, what we offer, and why they should trust us.
